citation: Liverani, Mario. 2006. Uruk: The First City. Edited and translated by Zainab Bahrani and Marc Van De Mieroop. London; Oakville: Equinox Publishing. ISBN 978-1-84553-191-1 (hardback); 978-1-84553-193-5 (paperback). Translation of Uruk: la prima città (Laterza, 1998).
notes: Short historical analysis of southern Mesopotamian urban/state origins in the Uruk period (most of the 4th millennium BCE). Title ‘First City’ is the author’s framing — do not treat as a ranked world-history verdict in fact columns. xii + ~97 pp. Page numbers not cited without inspection.
